recipes.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.

mechanism.clause: When this creature enters, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard.

recipe_coverage: Actual typed permanent entry; Oracle-bounded fixed window, filters and selected quantity, optional decline/mandatory choice, legal remainder ordering and zone conservation, both source controllers and targeted library ownership, exact ordinary costs, denied/countered casts where legal, actual bounce/reentry, creature-only blink and snapshots. Real Land entries use native land branch; repeated land entry occurs on a later own turn. Complete additional printed clauses are explicit gaps.
